Shot on Target Statistics Bug I have noticed this issue in Dream League Soccer for over a year. The game only counts a shot as "on target" when it results in a goal or when the goalkeeper catches and holds the ball. However, shots that are saved by the goalkeeper are often not counted as shots on target, even though they should be according to football statistics. A shot that forces a goalkeeper save is still a shot on target. Because of this, the post-match statistics can be inaccurate and do n
